request.system:
You answer a question about machines at work using ONLY the documents in the current folder: EU and
Italian law, guidance, manufacturers' manuals, a company's documents and a plant's records, one text file per
document. README.md lists them. Use your tools (Glob, Grep, Read) to find and read what you need; search in
English and in Italian, since the documents are in both languages.

Rules:
- Use only what the files say. Do not use anything you know from elsewhere.
- If the files do not answer the question, the kind is "unknown" and the value is null.
- If the question asks about a day, compare that day with the dates in the files.
- If the question asks "which" or "what" and several things answer it, list every one of them.
- If the question asks who does something and within what time, the kind is "text" and the value names both.
- When you have the answer, or are sure the files do not hold it, reply with JSON only, nothing before or after:
  {"kind": "set|date|duration|boolean|text|unknown",
   "value": <list of short strings for set | "YYYY-MM-DD" for date | ISO 8601 duration like "P10Y" | true/false | a short text | null>,
   "text": "one or two sentences for a person, naming the document and the article, section or page",
   "sources": [{"file": "<file name>", "place": "<heading of the section>", "quote": "<the sentence relied on, copied>"}]}
request.question: Given that the company works in mining areas (extractive sector), how often must the 35,000 kg GCB 35 gantry crane at position 23 be verified?

response.text: {"kind": "duration", "value": "P1Y", "text": "The GCB 35 gantry crane (position 23, Lula – Sos Enattos mine, built 1989, 35,000 kg) must be verified every year. Allegato VII of D.Lgs. 81/2008 requires annual verification for lifting equipment over 200 kg used in the extractive sector, and for fixed equipment built more than 10 years earlier. IGEA's technical sheet (Allegato A, table A5) confirms position 23 is in the mine at Lula.", "sources": [{"file": "DLGSALLVII.md", "place": "Allegato VII, riga 12", "quote": "Apparecchi di sollevamento materiali con portata superiore a 200 Kg. non azionati a mano, di tipo mobile o trasferibile, con modalità di utilizzo riscontrabili in settori di impiego quali costruzioni, siderurgico, portuale, estrattivo | Verifica annuale"}, {"file": "DLGSALLVII.md", "place": "Allegato VII, riga 15", "quote": "Apparecchi di sollevamento materiali con portata superiore a 200 Kg. non azionati a mano, di tipo fisso, con modalità di utilizzo riscontrabili in settori di impiego quali costruzioni, siderurgico, portuale, estrattivo e con anno di fabbricazione antecedente 10 anni | Verifiche annuali"}, {"file": "igea-equipment.md", "place": "p. 7, Tabella A5", "quote": "23 GRU A CAVALLETTO 35000 NU 16/95 1989 459 GCB 35 X 12/21 Classe: matr.459"}, {"file": "igea-equipment.md", "place": "p. 9, Tabella B3", "quote": "Lula (Sos Enattos) 23 GCB 35 X 35000 NU 16/95 1989 459 Lula CAVALLETTO - ex Rimisa"}]}
